content: स्मि €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (स्मयते, स्मित) .²1 To smile, laugh (gently); काकुत्स्थ ईषत्स्मयमान आस्त <ls>Bk. 2. 11</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">15. 8</ls>; स्मयमानं वदनाम्बुजं स्मरामि <ls>Bv. 2. 27</ls>. .²2 To bloom, expand; <ls>Pt. 1. 136</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (स्माययति-ते) .²1 To cause a smile by, cause to smile. .²2 To laugh at, deride. .²3 To astonish (स्माययते in this sense). --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (सिस्मयिषते) To wish to smile.
